qualifier_in_source: Holds on SMB; not replicated on other segments (scope limited to SMB; retention -1%)

judgments.note: Explicitly says confirmed for SMB only; other segments did not replicate.
States do not generalize beyond SMB; other segments did not replicate.
'SMB only' plus 'others did not replicate' preserves scope limit.
'SMB only' and 'no replication' convey the restriction.
'unreplicated' reads as uncertainty; no statement other segments failed.
Bare 'SMB' label plus 'unreplicated' implies uncertainty, not stated limit.
